sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 859)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across William Gargan as private eye Barrie Craig (1953), Phil Harper as Seattle detective Harry Nile on Jim French's *The Adventures of Harry Nile* (1992), two police procedural cases on *Under Arrest* (1953, 1954), Rudy Vallee crooning 'I Should Care' on *The Drene Show* (1945), and Bret Morrison narrating Elisabeth Ogilvie's coastal drama on *Best Sellers* (1945).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with credited performers, conductors, and story details recorded in the narrative description:
